details:
My idea for this feature is as follows:

You can assign people to a dedicated group of best friends, which offers them the following benefits:

1. In invite only instances and/or when your status is set to orange or red, any invite requests they make are automatically accepted so long as you have permission to invite them, with access while your status is red being something you can disable at a moment's notice in the settings menu. When someone has added you as a best friend, their online status indicator will have some kind of symbol signifying your elevated permissions to join them, like a little plus symbol or an insignia saying "BFF" on the corner of the indicator circle.

2. People who are mutually best friends can join "Best Friend Instances" where everyone involved has to be best friends with each other, and "Best Friends+ Instances" just requires that someone you're mutually best friends with is mutually best friends with the person they invite.

3. Setting someone to be your best friend will add a little indicator to their nametag when full nametags are enabled. When you've assigned each other as best friends mutually, that little indicator will be a different icon and/or a different color to show that you've both added each other. (Perhaps half of a heart shows up in gray when you've added them, and a full heart shows up in red when you've both added each other).

4. When setting someone as a best friend, there is an option to notify them of this change, but if their status is red (or was red last time they were online), the notification will be held internally until their status is no longer red. If you choose not to notify them of this change, the other related visual indicators (such as the status indicator showing them elevated permissions to join you which was mentioned prior) will remain intact regardless.

5. For quick and easy access, an option to put all friends from an existing friend group into your best friends list will be available, and it will *not* clear the initial group's member list upon doing so.
title: New Social Feature: "Best Friends" (Name not final and up to changing by the VRC team)
